'''Phase-knives''' were a type of blade developed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Philaxia/Legends|Philaxia]].

==Description==
Resembling a knife's hilt when deactivated, the phase-knife utilized technology resembling [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] designs. Projecting a weightless blade when turned on, the device utilized a molecular shield to form the razor-sharp weapon. Because of the rotoscoping effect of the blade, it was difficult to wield. The phase-knife's lengths size and shape was adjustable.<ref name="EV" />

==History==
Developed by artificers on the planet [[Philaxia/Legends|Philaxia]], the phase-knife was used by the criminal element there until the world's discovery by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. With the introduction of the [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] by Republic settlers, the phase-knife was largely discarded as a relic of the past until a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] discovered one decades later.
